description: This file contains functions related to SHA-1 collision detection integrated into a Git utility, including initialization, finalization with collision attack detection, and update functions with type adjustments.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCInit(SHA1_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Initializes the SHA1DC hash context and sets safe hash mode to default (0).

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCFinal(unsigned char hash[20],SHA1_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Finalizes the SHA-1 hash computation and triggers a fatal error if a collision attack is detected, displaying the hash in hex.

methods.name: void git_SHA1DCUpdate(SHA1_CTX * ctx,const void * vdata,unsigned long len)
methods.description: Updates the SHA1DC context with data, adjusting for large input sizes by chunking into INT_MAX segments.

ctags.name: git_SHA1DCUpdate
ctags.pattern: /^void git_SHA1DCUpdate(SHA1_CTX *ctx, const void *vdata, unsigned long len)$/
